summaryJa: FBIのFD-302（記入日10-/2025）に基づく面接記録。面接対象者（氏名は黒塗り）はコロラドスプリングス上空の航空機を頻繁に観察していると述べる。2023年10月の午後8時〜9時30分の間、同僚と星を見ていたところ、周辺視野で動きを感じ、暗灰色でピクセル状に歪んだように見える静止した雲が現れた。その雲から、三角形の黒い物体が出現し、前方下部に拡散した赤い光、三角の三角点それぞれに赤い光があったと報告した。目撃者は物体を駐車場ほどの大きさ、厚みは3〜5階建て相当、光は腕を伸ばした位置で爪大と推定した。最初は南およびやや東へヘリコプター程度の速度で高度約3000〜5000フィートで飛行し、ほぼ瞬時にマッハ1〜2と推定される速度で加速し方向を変えた。物体の周囲に蜃気楼のような波紋が見え、音や推進機構、異臭は感じられなかった。左側に90度急バンクして右へ逸れ、すぐ水平飛行に戻るという通常の航空機とは逆の動きをし、視界を失った。約60秒後に妻へ電話し、妻は声がロボットのように聞こえ通話に電子的干渉があった可能性を述べた。文書は結論や推奨を含まない旨を記す。
summaryEn: FD-302 interview record (entry dated 10-/2025). The interviewed witness (redacted) said they frequently observe military, commercial, and civilian aircraft over and around Colorado Springs. On an evening in October 2023 between 8:00 and 9:30 PM, while looking at stars with a coworker, the witness noticed peripheral movement and a stationary, dark-gray cloud that appeared pixelated or distorted. A solid black equilateral triangular object emerged from the cloud toward the south/southeast with a diffuse red light on the bottom front point and a red light at each corner. The witness estimated the object could be as large as the parking lot where they stood, about 3–5 stories thick; each light appeared fingernail-sized at arm’s length. Initially it moved south and slightly east at a helicopter-like speed at an estimated altitude of 3,000–5,000 feet, then almost instantaneously accelerated—possibly to Mach 1 or 2—and turned slightly south/southwest. The witness observed wave-like/mirage distortions around the object, heard no noise, saw no visible propulsion, and detected no unusual smell. The object abruptly banked 90 degrees left while veering right, then quickly returned to level flight (a banking motion opposite that of conventional aircraft). The witness lost sight of the object as it passed over a redacted location toward the south; the dark-gray cloud was later gone. About 60 seconds after the sighting the witness called his wife, who reported his voice sounded robotic, suggesting possible electronic interference. The FD-302 notes it contains no FBI conclusions or recommendations.
